import struct
data=open('/app/data.db','rb').read(); ps=4096
def varint(buf,pos):
    val=0
    for j in range(9):
        b=buf[pos]; pos+=1
        val=(val<<7)|(b&0x7f)
        if not (b&0x80):
            return val,pos
    return val,pos
for p in [3,4,5,6,7]:
    page=data[(p-1)*ps:p*ps]
    n=struct.unpack('>H',page[3:5])[0]
    rowids=[]
    for i in range(n):
        co=struct.unpack('>H',page[8+2*i:10+2*i])[0]
        cell=page[co:]
        payload,pos=varint(cell,0)
        rowid,pos=varint(cell,pos)
        rowids.append(rowid)
    print('page',p,'n',n,'rowids',rowids)
